notes.title: “Fading Afternoon” will release at Sep.14,Initial price 17.99$
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847328/d47f275830e2b791262fa731e8159955a620ebd2.png[/img]

Developed by yeo and published by Indieark, side-scrolling game "Fading Afternoon" will be released at 7 pm(PDT) on Sep.14! The price will be 19.99$, and you will also enjoy a 10% discount when it is released. You can play this latest game for only 17.99$!

"Fading Afternoon" tells the story of a middle-aged gangster, Seiji Maruyama, who returns to the gang after being released from prison. Before being imprisoned, Maruyama was an important force in the gang, but after a long prison life, Maruyama is getting old. After being released from prison, Maruyama also stood at the crossroads of his life. Going back to the gangsters to fight bloody for the honor of the past? Or change your mind and live an ordinary life? It all depends on your choice...

This game will start a series of stories around the protagonist-Maruyama Seiji. You can start a war with other gangs and regain your territory by fighting other gangs, or you can just hang out on the street, soak in hot springs, get massages, and be a fisherman. The game will enter different endings based on your actions and choices. You will witness with your own eyes what kind of path the aging Maruyama will take.
  This game will be released at 7 pm on Sep.14(PDT), so stay tuned!
